title: Proposal: notely
body:
### Image name

notely

### Upstream repository

https://github.com/notely-org/notely

### Project homepage

_No response_

### Licence

AGPL-3.0-only

### Latest stable release

https://github.com/notely-org/notely/releases/tag/v2.4.1

### How the image installs it

Release asset

### amd64 release asset

notely_2.4.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz

### arm64 release asset

_No response_

### Application type

Web application

### Runtime and install

A single Go binary in a tarball. Start it with `/app/notely/notely serve --data /config --port 8080`.

### Web interface port

8080

### Where it writes state

./data next to the binary by default; --data moves it.

### Required environment variables

- NOTELY_SECRET=changeme - signs session cookies
- `NOTELY_BASE_URL`: the public URL behind a proxy
PUID=1000

### Database

Embedded (SQLite or similar)

### First run

A setup page asks for the first admin account, then shows an empty notebook.

### Screenshot

_No response_

### Maintainers

notely-dev, @someone

### The Labs bar

- [X] The upstream repository is owned by an organisation, not a personal account
- [X] It has an approved open-source licence
- [X] It cuts stable, versioned releases
- [X] Release asset names stay the same from release to release
- [X] It works with just this container (no companion containers)
- [ ] It needs no account with a paid vendor service to work
- [X] Any telemetry is disclosed and can be turned off
